content.text: I’m fairly certain Tigerfest is being moved to the summer only because it used to be in the winter. They find it very compelling to assume that everything that happened the last 15 years had to be wrong.
I know. The purpose of TigerFest is to drum up interest. It’s supposed to be in the winter
Got your message, thanks, I didn’t know the box office had a union. How?

Seriously. The biggest problem with baseball is that 81 games is too many and now they want to add an event in the summer? Yea I’m not sure what the history is on that. As I understand it, it’s true of all 4 teams. Just something that goes back a long time I’m guessing.
I’m sure the players are going to be thrilled
We used to have a season ticket holder party that most of them wouldn’t come to. It’s a tough sell during the season, especially when you are embarrassed by the season you are having
